name: Abir Tasrif
headline: Textile Engineer × Tech Enthusiast
bio: I am a textile engineer turned tech enthusiast with deep expertise in industrial engineering, garment technology, and 3D fashion design. Over the years, I've worked across production floors, pattern rooms, and design studios — optimizing apparel manufacturing processes, creating technical packs, and building 3D garment simulations. Today, I combine that domain knowledge with modern web technologies to build software that solves real problems for the textile and apparel industry.
